entry.title: Subnautica: Below Zero
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺499,99 → ₺399,99 [₺199,99 ~ ₺499,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺399,99

Application Description

*Please make sure your device is supported before purchasing Below Zero!* Below Zero is the next chapter of Subnautica, the underwater survival open world set on an alien ocean planet. Submerge yourself in an all-new, sub-zero expedition in an arctic region of Planet 4546B. After crash landing planetside, set out into frigid waters to investigate what happened to your sister... Discover new biomes, creatures, challenges and story! Below Zero expands the Subnautica universe, diving deeper into the adventure and mysteries introduced in the original game. FEATURES UNCOVER THE TRUTH - Who were the aliens who came here before? Why were they on this planet? What really happened to your sister? And will exposing the truth give some closure to your loss? SURVIVE THE COLD - The freezing temperatures of this arctic region pose a new challenge. Craft a toasty cold suit, sip on piping hot coffee, and warm up next to Thermal Lilies to stave off the chill. CRAFT YOUR WAY - Survive the harsh climate by constructing extensive habitats, scavenging for resources, and crafting equipment. Blast across the snowy tundra on a Snowfox hoverbike. Cruise through enchanting and perilous biomes in your modular Seatruck. EXPLORE THE PLANET - Swim beneath the blue-lit, arching expanses of Twisty Bridges, be mesmerized by the Crystal Caverns, venture into the icy caves of Glacial Basin or maneuver between erupting Thermal Vents to discover ancient alien artifacts. MEET NEW CREATURES - Something undiscovered lurks around every corner. Swim through the giant Titan Holefish, encounter the haunting Shadow Leviathan, and visit the adorable Pengwings. Keep your wits about you. Not all creatures in this strange world are friendly. CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE - Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control - Game Center achievements - Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices - iPhone 17 Optimization (including Pro Max) ----- *DEVICES NOT SUPPORTED (THE GAME WON'T WORK)*: - iPhone Xr, iPhone SE Gen 2 (2020) - iPad Mini Gen 5, iPad Air Gen 3, iPad Gen 8, iPad Gen 9 *SUPPORTED DEVICES ON LOW RESOLUTION ONLY*: - iPhone Xs, iPhone Xs Max, iPhone 11, iPhone 11 Pro, iPhone 11 Pro Max, iPhone 12, iPhone 12 Mini, iPhone 13, iPhone 13 Mini, iPhone SE Gen 3 (2022) - iPad Pro 10.5", iPad Mini Gen 6, iPad Air Gen 4, iPad Gen 10, iPad Pro 11" Gen 1, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 3 *SUPPORTED DEVICES* : - iPhone 12 Pro, iPhone 12 Pro Max, iPhone 13 Pro, iPhone 13 Pro Max, iPhone 14 AND ABOVE - iPad Pro 11" Gen 2, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 4, iPad Air Gen 5, iPad Pro 11" Gen 3, iPad Pro 11" Gen 4, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 5, iPad Pro 12.9" Gen 6 AND ABOVE

Who says ships are only for the water? Why not take a voyage across a sea of clouds instead? On a little island, floating in the sky, your adventure begins... Hop on board your shining new airship and see what lies beyond the horizon! Gather your crew and explore regions of the sky where no one has ever been! entry.title: Demon Castle Story
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺399,99 → ₺249,99 [₺249,99 ~ ₺399,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺249,99

Application Description

A management simulation in which you take an old, run-down castle and turn it into a dastardly demon stronghold! Recruit unique monsters as your minions and vanquish adventurers who dare to enter your realm! Install gargoyles, ritual altars, and other devilish decor to boost your castle's mystique and attract more monsters your way. Gift them food and other items to help them grow, and garner their support to fend off pesky adventurers. You can also send your monster minions out to explore nearby dungeons and towns. They'll bring you back items and other loot, and maybe even some new allies! As you progress, you can also start merging monsters together to make new ones. And don't forget traps—essential equipment for proper castle defense! Develop a range of traps like sleep-inducing gas and heavy washbowls to thwart any who cross the threshold of your demonic haven! By placing and combining traps in imaginative ways, you can make your fortress of fiendishness virtually impregnable! Fend off attacks from mighty adventurers and keep your minions sweet to become the biggest and baddest demon overlord of all time! Search "Kairosoft" to see our other games. https://kairopark.jp We've got a whole range of free and one-time-purchase games to enjoy, many of which might feel familiar! Washed ashore a desolate island and surrounded by savage beasts, can you thrive...or merely survive? Blaze trails into unknown territory...and then make it your own! Plant crops, build housing and power sources, and transform the island into your own personal paradise. As you progress, you'll be able to develop new gear and technology to take your adventure to the next level, including ways to travel to unexplored islands nearby! The native fauna eyeing you as their next meal? Capture the critters, trade them with friends, and train them to fight for you! Most have elemental strengths and weaknesses, so use these to your advantage in battle. Venture far enough afield and you may find signs of civilization. If you make the right friends, your humble isle could grow into an economic powerhouse, complete with hot springs, hotels, and heliport. The possibilities are as limitless as the horizon! All Price Information

Price：₺99,99

Application Description

Every enchantment is a gamble. Some of them make you stronger. Others, change the world completely. Enchanted Survival is a survival roguelite. The weapons fire themselves, so the only thing you control is where you stand, and what you enchant and upgrade. Between waves the fighting stops and you walk to a lit shrine, feed it the crystals you picked up off the dead, and ask for an enchantment without being told what is coming. Most enchantments improve an item. Then a pair of boots comes back with Frozenfoot, the lake you have been fighting beside freezes solid under your feet, and the half of the map you could never reach is the half you fight on for the rest of the run. Over 650 enchantments across lots of equipment. Pay for a deeper ritual and the rare results get likelier, and now and then two arrive at once. A clue tells you what the rite is leaning toward. KEEP WHAT YOU ROLLED, OR PUSH IT Strengthen an enchantment through three tiers. Wager crystals at the anvil to temper a piece and raise its own number, then watch the bar run without knowing where it stops. Strip an enchantment out and free the socket. All of it is paid in the same crystals you could have spent on a fresh roll instead. TEN LEVELS THAT EACH FIGHT BACK A meadow built around a lake. A desert of pyramids and one oasis. Glacier basin, volcanic field, mushroom marsh, storm plateau, lighthouse coast, sunken ruins, crystal cavern. Some of them fall dark, and light turns into something you carry, place and stand near. THREE HEROES WHO PLAY DIFFERENTLY The Adventurer, who starts the way the game was written. The Fisher, who swims open water instead of drowning in it and gets chased faster for the privilege. The Ranger, who opens with the bow and turns every ritual up a level. CARRY ONE THING FORWARD Clear a level and one worn item comes with you into every run after it. Finish a run and it pays out shards, which the stall at the head of the road turns into a second weapon, a better starting item, or a first ritual rolled a level deeper than you paid for. FEATURES - Over 650 enchantments, every one of them doing something you can see - Enchant, strengthen, temper and strip, all on one currency - Elites, minibosses and bosses that hold the wave until they fall - Dark levels where light is something you have to bring - A Codex and a bestiary that fill in as you go - One thumb, landscape, built for a phone - Eight languages - Paid once. No ads, no in-app purchases, fully offline
